intro.tagline: I build Laravel & React systems for finance and industry — and keep the IT behind them running.
intro.now: Building a digital subscriptions & redemptions app at Alphavest Asset Management.

about.heading: About
about.title: Two hats, one owner — from server to interface.
about.p1: I hold a degree in Application Development Engineering (FST Tanger) and a Full Stack Developer certification from Webforce3. Since 2022, I've worked across four internships and my current role, building enterprise applications with Laravel and React while picking up hands-on IT infrastructure experience along the way.
about.p2: At Alphavest Asset Management I wear two hats: I run core IT services — backups, domain administration, support and system maintenance — and I built the firm's KYC compliance application with Laravel and Livewire. I'm now building its digital subscriptions and redemptions app with Spring Boot and React Native. That lets me own a project end to end, from the server to the interface.

items.desc: Own the company's day-to-day IT operations — backups, domain administration, support and system maintenance — built the internal KYC application, and now develop the digital subscriptions and redemptions app.
Took an internal tool from stakeholder requirements to a working Laravel application — my first build owned end to end in a professional setting.
Final-year engineering project in an industrial environment: worked with plant and laboratory teams to replace a paper-based workflow with a digital one.
Built production interfaces with React.js, turning UX requirements into a responsive product for a travel-tech company.
Built desktop software with Java and JavaFX — internal tools used in day-to-day business operations.
